metadata.name: protocol_adapter
metadata.description: Solana Protocol Adapter for Anoma Resource Machine

instructions.name: deny_logic_refs
docs: Add logic refs to the denylists, each to the one for consumed
resources (`consumed`) or to the one for created resources. Mirrors
pa-evm's `denyLogicRefs`: owner-only, the zero ref and a ref already on
its denylist are rejected, no entry is ever removed, and each addition
emits `LogicRefDenied`. A ref on the created side only is
deprecated: transactions still consume its resources. A ref on both is
denied. The owner pays for the entries.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The owner, which pays for the denylists' growth.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Initialize a new PAState account, owned by `initial_owner`.
Signed by the program's upgrade authority, the deployer, who alone may
initialize it; it hands that authority to the program's
`UPGRADE_AUTHORITY_SEED` PDA, so from then on only `upgrade`, for the
owner, upgrades the program. Takes no remaining accounts. The
empty-tree root equals `PADDING_LEAF`, which `is_root_valid` accepts
unconditionally, so transactions built against the initial tree stay
valid without a genesis marker. Like pa-evm's initializer, it sets the
owner, starts on the empty kind tree, and announces both;
`set_kind_tree_root` installs any other kind tree.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: This program's ProgramData, where the loader records the upgrade
authority: the deployer, who alone initializes the adapter and hands
the authority to `upgrade_authority`.

accounts.name: upgrade_authority
docs: seeds pin it.

accounts.name: verifier_entry
docs: initialized selector (`verifier_paused`).

instructions.name: pause
docs: Pause settlement. Mirrors pa-evm's `pause()`: owner-only, refused
while already paused (`EnforcedPause`), announced with `Paused`.
While paused, `settle`, `settle_from_txdata` and `simulate_execute`
refuse every transaction; nothing else is gated.
A permanent shutdown is a pause followed by `renounce_ownership`, as
on pa-evm: with no owner, no one can unpause or upgrade.
`close_markers_batch`, which requires a paused adapter, exists only in
`dev-teardown` builds (never present in production) to reclaim a
development deployment's marker rent.

instructions.name: renounce_ownership
docs: Give up the ownership for good. Mirrors OwnableUpgradeable's
`renounceOwnership`: owner only; the owner becomes the zero key, so
no owner-only instruction, `upgrade` included, can run again.

instructions.name: risc_zero_verifier_paused
docs: Whether the router has paused the verifier this deployment routes to.
Mirrors pa-evm's `riscZeroVerifierPaused()`: read by simulation.

accounts.name: verifier_entry
docs: deployment's selector (`verifier_paused`).

instructions.name: set_kind_tree_root
docs: Replace the stored kind tree root: from then on a transaction settles
when proven against this kind tree or against the empty one. Mirrors
pa-evm's `setKindTreeRoot`: authority only, zero rejected, the change
emitted. A kind tree changes whenever a token or a circuit version is
listed, and transactions proven against the previous kind tree are
rejected from this point on.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Settle a transaction: verify proofs, update commitment tree, mark nullifiers.

accounts.name: new_root_marker
docs: Cannot use a seeds constraint: the address depends on the resulting root,
which is only known after commitments are appended. Absent when the
settlement creates nothing and so produces no root.

instructions.name: settle_from_txdata
docs: Execute settlement from a TxData account.

accounts.name: new_root_marker
docs: Cannot use a seeds constraint: the address depends on the resulting root,
which is only known after commitments are appended. Absent when the
settlement creates nothing and so produces no root.

instructions.name: simulate_execute
docs: pa-evm's `simulateExecute`: settles `transaction_data` as `settle`
does, without verifying its RISC Zero proof when
`skip_risc_zero_proof_verification` is set (the proof's selector is
still checked), and then fails with `Simulated`, so nothing it did
lands. A transaction that would not execute fails with the error
`settle` would.

accounts.name: new_root_marker
docs: Cannot use a seeds constraint: the address depends on the resulting root,
which is only known after commitments are appended. Absent when the
settlement creates nothing and so produces no root.

instructions.name: transfer_ownership
docs: Move the ownership to `new_owner`. Mirrors OwnableUpgradeable's
`transferOwnership`: owner only, effective at once, the zero key
refused (`OwnableInvalidOwner`), announced with
`OwnershipTransferred`.

instructions.name: txdata_close
docs: Close a TxData account and reclaim rent.

instructions.name: txdata_close_expired
docs: Close an expired TxData account. Anyone can call; rent goes to `refund`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone can call, pays tx fee.

instructions.name: txdata_extend
docs: Extend the expiration deadline of a TxData account.

accounts.name: pa_state
docs: PAState for reading configurable expiry bounds.

instructions.name: txdata_init
docs: Initialize a TxData account for chunked upload.

accounts.name: pa_state
docs: PAState for reading configurable expiry bounds.

instructions.name: txdata_write
docs: Write a chunk to TxData.

instructions.name: unpause
docs: Resume settlement. Mirrors pa-evm's `unpause()`: owner-only, refused
while not paused (`ExpectedPause`), announced with `Unpaused`.

instructions.name: update_expiry_config
docs: Update TxData expiry configuration (authority only).

instructions.name: upgrade
docs: Replace this program's code with the code in `buffer`. Mirrors the
UUPS `upgradeToAndCall` pa-evm's owner calls: owner only
(`_authorizeUpgrade`), announced with `Upgraded`, which names the
new code by its executable hash as ERC1967's `Upgraded` names the new
implementation. The buffer's authority must be the owner, who wrote
it; the program hands it to its upgrade authority PDA, which signs the
upgrade, and its rent goes to `spill`. The new code
runs from the next slot, so a release that changes a layout ships a
migration the owner runs after it.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: address pins it.

accounts.name: upgraded_program
docs: the address pins it.

accounts.name: buffer
docs: loader requires to be the owner, who signs; `executable_hash` refuses
any other account.

accounts.name: upgrade_authority
docs: the seeds pin it.

instructions.name: version
docs: The release this build is. Mirrors pa-evm's `VERSION`: read from the
deployed program (by simulation), it names the code an address runs,
which an in-place upgrade changes.

types.name: ActionExecuted
docs: Mirrors pa-evm: `event ActionExecuted(bytes32 actionTreeRoot,
bytes32[] nullifiers, bytes32[] consumedLogicRefs, bytes32[] commitments,
bytes32[] createdLogicRefs);`. The commitments are appended to the tree in
the order listed, action after action.

types.name: ApplicationPayload
docs: Mirrors pa-evm: `event ApplicationPayload(bytes32 indexed tag, uint256
index, bytes blob);`.

types.name: CommitmentTreeRootAdded
docs: Mirrors pa-evm: `event CommitmentTreeRootAdded(bytes32 root);`: the
empty tree's root at initialization, then the root each settlement that
appends commitments produces.

types.name: DeniedLogicRef
docs: A logic ref to add to a denylist, as pa-evm's `DeniedLogicRef`:
`consumed` names the denylist for consumed resources, else the one for
created resources.

types.name: DiscoveryPayload
docs: Mirrors pa-evm: `event DiscoveryPayload(bytes32 indexed tag, uint256
index, bytes blob);`.

types.name: ExternalPayload
docs: Mirrors pa-evm: `event ExternalPayload(bytes32 indexed tag, uint256 index,
bytes blob);`.

types.name: ForwarderCallExecuted
docs: Mirrors pa-evm: `event ForwarderCallExecuted(address indexed
untrustedForwarder, bytes input, bytes output);`.

types.name: Initialized
docs: Mirrors OpenZeppelin Initializable: `event Initialized(uint64 version);`.
`initialize` announces the state's schema version.

types.name: KindTreeRootUpdated
docs: Mirrors pa-evm: `event KindTreeRootUpdated(bytes32 indexed kindTreeRoot);`.

types.name: LogicRefDenied
docs: Mirrors pa-evm: `event LogicRefDenied(bytes32 indexed logicRef, bool
consumed);`.

types.name: OwnershipTransferred
docs: Mirrors OpenZeppelin Ownable: `event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed
previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);`. The zero key stands for no
owner: the previous owner when `initialize` sets the first one, the new owner when `renounce_ownership` gives it up.

types.name: PAStateAccount
docs: Protocol Adapter state — commitment tree frontier with variable depth (0-32).
Nullifiers and historical roots are stored as separate PDA marker accounts.

fields.name: schema_version
docs: Layout number of this account's bytes. Always the first field, so it
sits at byte 8 of the account data (after Anchor's discriminator) in
every layout: a later binary that changes the layout reads this byte
through an unchecked account to decide whether it may migrate. Every
instruction that reads this account — all but `initialize`, which
creates it, and the development-only `dev_set_schema_version` —
refuses an account whose version is not `SCHEMA_VERSION`. A layout
change bumps the constant and may add, remove or reorder the other
fields: the release that makes it ships a migration that parses the
previous layout explicitly.

fields.name: owner
docs: The adapter's owner, as OpenZeppelin's `OwnableUpgradeable` stores
pa-evm's: it signs every owner-only instruction, upgrades the program
(`upgrade`), and moves or renounces the ownership
(`transfer_ownership`, `renounce_ownership`). The all-zero key once
renounced, which no one can sign for.

fields.name: verifier_router
docs: Verifier router program ID, set at initialization.
Mirrors pa-evm's immutable `RISC_ZERO_VERIFIER_ROUTER`.

fields.name: proof_selector
docs: Expected proof selector (4 bytes), set at initialization.
Validated before sending proofs to the verifier router.

fields.name: kind_tree_root
docs: The stored kind tree root: the empty kind tree's at initialization,
replaced by `set_kind_tree_root`. The aggregation circuit binds
each transaction to one kind tree, by the Merkle root of its entries;
a transaction settles when that is this kind tree or the empty one
(`is_kind_tree_root_accepted`), as in pa-evm.

fields.name: paused
docs: Whether settlement is paused, as pa-evm's `paused()`: `pause` sets it
and `unpause` clears it, both owner-only.

fields.name: root
docs: The latest root added to the set of past roots (each has its marker
PDA): the tree's root after the last settlement that added
commitments, computed once after its last one (`merkle::current_root`),
as pa-evm's `latestCommitmentTreeRoot`.

fields.name: current_depth
docs: Tree depth (0-32). Capacity = 2^current_depth.

fields.name: frontier
docs: Filled subtree hashes at each level. Grows via realloc when tree expands.

fields.name: denied_consumed_logic_refs
docs: The denylist for consumed resources, as pa-evm's: no settlement
consumes a resource whose logic ref the owner added to it
(`deny_logic_refs`). Only ever grows, by one 32-byte entry per denial.

fields.name: denied_created_logic_refs
docs: The denylist for created resources, as pa-evm's: no settlement
creates a resource whose logic ref the owner added to it. Only ever
grows, by one 32-byte entry per denial.

types.name: Paused
docs: Mirrors OpenZeppelin Pausable: `event Paused(address account);`.

types.name: ResourcePayload
docs: Mirrors pa-evm: `event ResourcePayload(bytes32 indexed tag, uint256 index,
bytes blob);`.

types.name: TransactionExecuted
docs: Mirrors pa-evm: `event TransactionExecuted(bytes32 indexed transactionId);`,
the Keccak-256 hash of the concatenated action tree roots: the message the
delta proof signs, unique per transaction and known to the sender before
submission.

types.name: TxDataAccount
docs: Chunked transaction upload buffer.

fields.name: refund
docs: Account to receive rent refund on close.

fields.name: payload
docs: Sized per upload by `space`; `INIT_SPACE` counts it empty.

types.name: U256
docs: A 256-bit unsigned integer: 32 little-endian bytes.

types.name: Unpaused
docs: Mirrors OpenZeppelin Pausable: `event Unpaused(address account);`.

types.name: Upgraded
docs: Mirrors ERC1967: `event Upgraded(address indexed implementation);`. A
Solana program keeps its address across upgrades, so the new code is
named by its executable hash: sha256 of the code without trailing zero
bytes, which `solana-verify get-program-hash` reports for the deployed
program.

constants.name: EMPTY_KIND_TREE_ROOT
docs: The root of the empty kind tree, under which every resource kind is
derived via hash-to-curve: the kind tree every deployment starts on, as
pa-evm's `EMPTY_KIND_TREE_ROOT`. A Merkle tree without entries has its
padding leaf as its root, `sha256("EMPTY")`.

constants.name: MAX_EXPIRY_SLOTS
docs: Default maximum expiry (~24 hours at 400ms/slot).

constants.name: MIN_ALLOWED_EXPIRY
docs: Hard floor for `min_expiry_slots` configuration (~4 seconds at 400ms/slot).

constants.name: MIN_EXPIRY_SLOTS
docs: Default minimum expiry (~40 seconds at 400ms/slot).

constants.name: NULLIFIER_SEED
docs: Seeds prefix for nullifier PDA derivation.

constants.name: ROOT_SEED
docs: Seeds prefix for root marker PDA derivation.

constants.name: SCHEMA_VERSION
docs: The layout number of `PAStateAccount` this binary reads and writes.
Bumped on every change to the account layout; unrelated to release names.

constants.name: SEVEN_DAYS_SLOTS
docs: Hard ceiling for `max_expiry_slots` configuration (~7 days at 400ms/slot).

constants.name: UPGRADE_AUTHORITY_SEED
docs: Seed of the PDA that is the program's upgrade authority once initialized:
the loader accepts an upgrade only signed by it, which only this program
can sign, and only in `upgrade`, for the owner. pa-evm's UUPS
implementation likewise authorizes its own upgrades (`_authorizeUpgrade`,
owner only).
